name: Threat from Below

angles.text: Defeating the sea giant removes a dangerous colossus from the shore beside the Horde's heartland.
As an orc, you know honor means facing titanic foes and answering “blood and thunder” against overwhelming might.
As a warrior, you face a test of endurance in direct combat with one of the coast's heaviest brutes.

faq.answer: Horde warriors are called to hunt a dangerous sea giant along Durotar's northern coast and bring back proof of the deed.
faq.q: What is the quest Threat from Below?

faq.answer: The sea giant roams the waters and shores along Durotar's north coast.
faq.q: Where is the sea giant found?

faq.answer: Sea giants are massive, ancient coastal behemoths created to dredge the oceans and shape Azeroth's coastlines. Few wanderers survive facing one directly.
faq.q: What kind of creature is a sea giant?

faq.answer: A huge creature prowling so close to Durotar endangers coastal travelers, fishermen, and Horde encampments along the shore.
faq.q: Why does the sea giant need to be eliminated?

faq.answer: “Blood and thunder” is a traditional orcish battle cry honoring martial strength, ferocity, and glory in victory against dangerous foes.
faq.q: What does the quest giver mean by 'blood and thunder'?

faq.answer: Proof of the sea giant's fall must be brought back from Durotar's north coast to verify that the beast has been slain.
faq.q: What proof is required to complete the task?

sections.body: A sea giant prowls Durotar's northern coast, where the Great Sea meets jagged sand and rocky shores. Scavengers and crabs usually roam there. Now the giant moves through the shallows, threatening coastal travelers and those who secure the waters beside the Horde's new homeland.
sections.title: The Northern Coastline

sections.body: Sea giants can shatter longboats and crush warriors beneath their fists. Bringing one down is a hard fight for young adventurers. Those who succeed earn deep respect among the orcs. Their cry of “blood and thunder” rings across Durotar's dry red bluffs.
sections.title: A Titan of the Waves

summary: Along Durotar's northern coast, Threat from Below puts travelers and the nearby waters in danger. A sea giant prowls the shore, and defeating it earns the respect of Durotar's warriors.
attribution: In-game quest text: Threat from Below
